mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) while empagliflozin increases urinary glucose excretion and can impair renal function, compounding nephrotoxicity risk and increasing risk of diabetic ketoacidosis.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and glucose closely; consider alternative antiviral if possible; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for DKA symptoms.
